hero.title: Secure escrow for CS2 item trades
hero.subtitle: Your item and your payment change hands through an automatic, neutral escrow.
hero.ctaDisabledHint: Platform is under maintenance. Please try again later.

sellerStarts.title: Seller starts the trade
sellerStarts.description: Create a new transaction with the item, price, and buyer details.

itemEscrowed.title: Item goes into escrow
itemEscrowed.description: The item is sent to the platform bot on Steam and held safely.

buyerPays.title: Buyer sends payment
buyerPays.description: USDT/USDC is sent to the provided address and verified on-chain automatically.

autoSettle.title: Automatic delivery & payout
autoSettle.description: The item is delivered to the buyer and the seller's payout is released in the same step.

automation.title: Automatic verification
automation.body: Payment and delivery steps are verified by the system, not by a human.

login.title: Sign in to Skinora
login.subtitle: Skinora uses your Steam account to verify your identity. You will be redirected to Steam to complete the sign-in.
login.benefitSecurity: Your Steam credentials are never sent to Skinora.
login.benefitNoPassword: No new password to remember — sign in with one click.
login.benefitNoRegistration: No separate registration: your Steam profile is your account.

auth_failed.title: Sign-in failed
auth_failed.body: Steam could not verify your sign-in. Please try again.

steam_unavailable.title: Steam is unavailable
steam_unavailable.body: Steam is temporarily unreachable. Please try again in a few minutes.

temporarily_locked.title: Too many attempts
temporarily_locked.body: For your security, sign-in is temporarily locked. Please try again later.
temporarily_locked.bodyWithMinutes: For your security, sign-in is temporarily locked. Please try again in {minutes} minutes.

account_banned.title: Account banned
account_banned.body: Your Skinora account has been banned. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

unknown.title: Sign-in error
unknown.body: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again.

tos.title: Welcome to Skinora
tos.description: Please review and accept before continuing.

summary.escrow: Your item and payment are held in escrow until both sides settle.
summary.commission: A commission is taken from the seller upon completion.
summary.crypto: Payments use USDT or USDC on the TRON network only.
summary.disputes: Disputes are reviewed by Skinora administrators.
summary.kyc: Sanctions-listed wallets and embargoed regions are blocked.

tos.ageCheckbox: I confirm I am at least 18 years old.
tos.tosCheckbox: I have read and accept the <link>Terms of Service</link>.
tos.notEligible: I am not eligible to continue

mobileAuthenticator.title: Steam Mobile Authenticator required
mobileAuthenticator.description: You need an active Steam Mobile Authenticator before you can start a transaction on Skinora.
mobileAuthenticator.step1: Install the Steam mobile app on your phone.
mobileAuthenticator.step2: Sign in with your Steam account.
mobileAuthenticator.step3: Open Steam Guard and follow the Mobile Authenticator setup.
mobileAuthenticator.step4: Wait at least 7 days before initiating a trade (Steam hold period).
mobileAuthenticator.dashboardNote: You can browse Skinora, but cannot start a transaction until your authenticator is active.

geoBlock.title: Access restricted
geoBlock.description: Access to Skinora is restricted from your region.
geoBlock.info: The platform is not available in certain jurisdictions due to legal and compliance requirements. Specific countries are not listed.

ageGate.title: Age requirement not met
ageGate.description: You must be at least 18 years old to use Skinora.

sanctions.title: Action blocked
sanctions.description: Your account is restricted by Skinora's compliance policy.
sanctions.info: Any active transactions have been placed on emergency hold and an administrator will review your case.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.description: Your account has been suspended by Skinora. You cannot start new transactions or accept existing ones.
suspended.activeTransactionsNote: Some active transactions may continue automatically. Steps that require your action may not advance and may time out. You can still view their details (read-only).

cancelModal.title: Are you sure you want to cancel this transaction?
